title: llmll verify --json document
description: Shape of the one JSON document `llmll --json verify <file> [flags]` prints on stdout once the file type-checks (TRUST-REPORT-GATE-1, design docs/design/trust-report-gate-1-proposal.md §3.3; emitter compiler/src/LLMLL/VerifyEnvelope.hs). Exactly one document is printed for every combination of flags, and `exit_code` equals the process status. Key order: `verify_json_version`, `exit_code`, `solver_verdict`, `composed`, then the verdict keys (the pre-v0.30.0 verdict object, unchanged), then each requested report under its fixed key, present only when it was computed. Emit-only: the compiler never re-parses this document. Versioning is independent of the JSON-AST schema and of the trust-report schema; `composed` names the versions of the nested reports. Additive-only changes within a major version; a breaking shape change increases the major. The verdict keys listed here are the ones the emitter writes today; the top level stays open (`additionalProperties` true) because a verdict key may be added without a version change, as before v1.0.0. A file that fails to parse or type-check gets the diagnostics output instead of this document.

exit_code.description: The process exit status. 0 SAFE; 1 refuted, solver error, or a strict-core refusal; 3 solver not on PATH (the proof did not run); 4 a contradiction found by a reporting or prover flag on an otherwise passing run.

solver_verdict.description: `not-run` when the run stopped before the solver: the pre-solver `--strict-verified-core` refusal, or no solver on PATH (exit 3).

trust_report_version.description: Version of the nested `trust_report` (docs/llmll-trust-report.schema.json). Present whether or not the report is nested.

schema_version.description: The JSON-AST schema version this compiler reads (docs/llmll-ast.schema.json).

obligation_report_schema_version.description: The nested `obligation_report`'s own `schema_version`; present only when that report is present.

trust_report.description: Under `--trust-report`, `--strict-verify` or `--cdp` (SAFE). The same shape `llmll trust-report <file> --json` prints bare.

spec_coverage.description: Under `--spec-coverage` or `--strict-verify`. The same shape `llmll spec-coverage <file> --json` prints bare.

weakness.description: Under `--weakness-check` or `--strict-verify`, after a SAFE result; `weaknesses` is empty when the check found nothing.
